outcome: Risk factors for unintended lower segment uterine extension during cesarean delivery (CD)
Maternal and neonatal adverse outcomes related to unintended uterine extension during CD
cohort: Singleton pregnancies delivered by CD at a single, university-affiliated medical center between January 1, 2018 and December 31, 2019
finding: The study found that second-stage CD was the strongest predictor for unintended uterine extension.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery during the second stage of labor was significantly associated with unintended uterine extension (adjusted odds ratio 54.2, 95% CI 4.5-648.9, p = .002).
